title: trace reproducer-instrumentation.json
description: Optional sibling file at <bundle-dir>/reproducer-instrumentation.json. Data-config that opts a bundle's Builder runs into instrumented compilation modes or build-time knobs. Out-of-band relative to the model: Reproducer and Patcher do NOT see this file, by design. Builder reads it, validates it, threads the mode through BuildRunner.run() for the unpatched/patched reproducer phases, and records the active state under build.json.instrumentation + build.json.disable_doCheck. v0 supports asan only; UBSAN/MSAN/TSAN are explicitly out of scope. disable_doCheck added at v0.3 of the contract (per docs/REPRODUCER_V1.md §2.7) for slow-check packages whose nixpkgs check phase blows the Builder timeout despite the underlying derivation being fine.

disable_doCheck.description: When true, the Builder applies overrideAttrs(doCheck=false) to the patched-build sanity-phase derivation (and to the unpatched/patched reproducer-run derivations when they wrap nixpkgs packages that carry doCheck=true). The CVE-class regression dimension is covered by the Reproducer-run phases themselves; the patched-build is just a sanity build, and a 30+ minute check suite is wasted CI time. Default: false. Affects build behaviour only; build.json records the active state as build.json.disable_doCheck.
